sentences.en: The New York Times reviews her gallery all the time.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》经常对她举办的画展进行评论。

sentences.en: You should drop by his gallery if you have time.
sentences.zh: 如果你有时间的话，可以去他那个地方看看。

sentences.en: A spiral staircase leads onto the gallery of the church.
sentences.zh: 螺旋楼梯通向教堂的回廊。

senses.zh: 挖地道 形容词: galleried
